name: hsv-hue-sweep
prompt: A full-frame rainbow that sweeps its hue over time; add a saturation slider and desaturate the bottom third using luminance.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer: a full-frame diagonal rainbow whose hue sweeps over time (uSpeed, uBands), with a uSaturation slider (0–1). The bottom third blends toward luma() gray, controlled by uBottomDesat and a soft edge (uEdgeSoft). I haven't compiled or rendered it because no Powermove tools were attached, and it assumes uv.y = 0 is the bottom of the frame.
